assumptions: Both dumbbells are held at the same time, so the exercise is bilateral and repetition-based.
The shoulders sweep the arms with slightly bent elbows in a plane parallel to the floor.
classification_reasons: The exercise is a straight-arm sweep of dumbbells from the thighs to overhead along a semicircular path while lying supine. The joint action is shoulder elevation through the body's frontal plane, with scapular upward rotation. It is closest to a pullover or lateral raise pattern.

The schema's required primary_movement_family list (squat, hip_hinge, horizontal/vertical push and pull, loaded_carry, elbow flexion/extension, knee flexion/extension, ankle_plantarflexion, trunk_flexion) has no exact family for this movement.
Labelling it horizontal_push, vertical_push or a pull family would be a nearest-but-wrong category, so no faithful definition can be written.
